text:
Aisha (Billing): heads up - noticed a small but consistent set of subscription invoices where proration lines are missing in NetSuite after sync. Stripe shows proration amounts but NS line items are blank. Seen ~23 invoices since deploy.

Tom (Payments): ack. Which deploy? We rolled out the lightweight line-item mapper Friday. It changed how prorations are grouped.

Aisha (Billing): yes that one. Example: stripe inv inv_9bXy created 2026-03-22 14:03 UTC, shows proration -15.00 EUR on stripe, but NS invoice ns_778 created with no proration line, total equals non-prorated amount.

Riley (Accounting): missing proration breaks revenue recognition and skews month-to-month MRR. We need a fix and backfill. Prefer backfill that posts correction lines rather than editing historic invoices.

Sam (Platform): quick debug: WebhookBot logs show the invoice.created payload included lines.proration with prorate=true, but our mapper dropped items where unit_price = 0 after a currency rounding step. Looks like rounding moved -0.00 to 0 and filter removed it.

WebhookBot: 1 webhook reprocessed (id: replay_334) - payload archived at s3://redwood-webhooks/2026/03/22/inv_9bXy.json

Tom (Payments): so root cause: rounding -> zero -> dropped. But Stripe shows non-zero in display because of negative fractional cents aggregated. We should change mapper to preserve small non-zero prorate lines and keep them as cents.

Aisha (Billing): Agreed. For remediation: 1) run dry-run to list affected invoices and compute missing proration total; 2) create NetSuite credit/adjustment lines or post a small invoice amendment preserving audit trail.

Riley (Accounting): prefer posting a small adjustment invoice (or credit) referencing original NS id. Include audit note "proration-correction:2026-03-22". Also include original Stripe invoice link.

Sam (Platform): I'll patch mapper to stop dropping lines with absolute cents < 1 and to maintain integer cents. Also add unit tests for proration edgecases. Will deploy a hotfix in the next 2 hours to staging then prod after signoff.

Tom (Payments): Tom/Platform will produce a CSV dry-run: columns: stripe_invoice, stripe_customer, ns_invoice, missing_proration_cents, currency, suggested_action. I'll drop it in #finance-private when ready.

Aisha (Billing): timeline: need CSV by EOD today. If total impact < 5k EUR we can schedule automated adjustments in weekend window; if >5k escalate for manual review.

Riley (Accounting): include sample of 5 affected invoices for manual verification before run. Also add GL impact estimate column.

Sam (Platform): noted. Also adding alert: if webhook DLQ > 2 for invoice.created, pause auto-replay and notify billing oncall.

Aisha (Billing): thanks. Proceed with dry-run and hotfix. Keep this thread updated when CSV is posted.

WebhookBot: monthly_exports will run Wed 06:00 UTC. Consider pausing during remediation window to avoid dupes.
